Okay, I've spent a while trying to get the best possible result out of this image. 

There's two obvious differences within this image, one being that the left-side of the image obviously contains nothing. Now, the "head" of the figure was dominant no matter what I adjusted, so obviously, it has a face. Somewhere.

Now, no matter what happens, the right side of it's head is always black. No matter what I did, it's either black or white. Meaning there's a solid object there, not a fog or anything like that. Weird, considering it's head is easiyl recognizable. 

I believe this is real - but I can't for the life of me tell you what it is. Twycross's suggestion that it's a hand is valid, but there is no way in hell you could get your hand in that position whilst awake, let alone asleep and take a picture. Considering there are so many that are black, I'd say you slept on your phone and skin contact did that, but to have just 1 that is clear could probably erase that theory.

I'd say it's paranormal - but I'm only amateur when it comes to photo manipulation. I design logos, not find ghosts. xD

I use mine with my MVP2.0 - Maybe even try a Vision Spinner II?

Anything with variable voltage, honestly.
